title: Air traffic controller watches the F-5 chase

tellings.quote: You know, the object was just playing hideand seek. it would just show up and appear at a very distant point.

plain: In 1986 an unknown object led Brazilian F-5 fighter jets on a chase over São Paulo, popping up and vanishing like a game of hide and seek. Jose Manuel Fernandez, an air traffic controller at the city's Congonhas airport, tells Michels he watched it happen: "the object was just playing hide and seek. It would just show up and appear at a very distant point." To him, that was something no ordinary aircraft could do.
